SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalRequests, SUM(CASE WHEN success_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successRequests, SUM(CASE WHEN success_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failRequests, AVG(response_time) AS avgResponseTime FROM sys_api_monitor
create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT api_path AS apiPath, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, SUM(CASE WHEN success_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN success_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount, AVG(response_time) AS avgTime, MAX(create_time) AS lastAccessTime FROM sys_api_monitor
api_path LIKE CONCAT('%', #{apiPath}, '%')
AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
GROUP BY api_path ORDER BY avgTime DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_api_monitor WHERE create_time >= CURRENT_DATE AND create_time < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day'
